name: Blood Temple
source:
Congratulations! You've just been picked as the next offering to the temple ! Not only does no one ever come back but you've heard the monsters inside could cause the most gruesome death imaginable. But wait there seems to be someone else with you?

Can you trust him?

[From [url=https://galengames.itch.io/blood-temple]itch.io[/url]]
